interface.name: agentseat_control_v1
interface.description: Internal AgentSeat protocol. Exactly one Wayland client may own the gate. Virtual input is accepted only from this same client while granted. Acquire and subsequent virtual input use the same Wayland connection, so an old acquire/input sequence cannot overtake a newer acquire. Human activity revokes delivery immediately at the compositor and advances the epoch. The quiet period never automatically restores a grant. This is an operation-ordering boundary, not protection from malicious applications running with the same user privileges.

entry.name: already_owned
entry.summary: another client owns the input gate

request.name: hold_timeout
request.description: Each new virtual key/button press has an absolute deadline. Repeated acquire calls cannot extend an existing hold. Expiry revokes the gate.

request.name: window_action
request.description: Actions: 1 focus, 2 move, 3 resize, 4 request close. A successful close acknowledgement means delivery to the client, not destruction; the application retains its save/cancel behavior. Unknown actions reject.

request.name: clipboard_offer

description.summary: bounded private clipboard under the input gate

request.description: The sealed fd holds at most 32768 UTF-8 bytes. Selection expires after ten seconds or any revocation. Transfer is not application insertion.

event.name: content
event.description: Sent after an output commit that carried scene damage. Forced repaints for captures and frame-clock commits without damage do not advance the serial. Cursor-only motion is not scene content. The box bounds the damage in output buffer pixels; area is the sum of its damage rectangles in the same units.
